basic_details.short_information: Delhi State Cancer Institutes (DSCI), a group of autonomous institutions under the Govt of NCT of Delhi, will hold a walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 (Friday), with registration of candidates from 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM, at the Director's Office at DSCI (East), whose campus the letterhead gives as Dilshad Garden, Delhi 110095. The walk-in under Advertisement Number RECTT./17/2026 is for 40 Senior Resident posts on ad-hoc basis for 44 days (extendable) in eight specialities: Clinical Oncology / Radiotherapy, Onco-Anaesthesia, Intensive & Critical Care, Nuclear Medicine, Onco-Imaging / Radiodi

important_instructions: Tenure: the initial appointment is for 44 days and can be extended for further 44 days by giving one day break, on a written request recommended and forwarded by the concerned HOD, or till regular incumbents join, whichever is earlier. The maximum tenure of the Senior Resident post is 03 years, including previous tenure served in any govt. Hospital/Institute/Organization; earlier SR service in Govt. hospitals/autonomous bodies counts, and an undertaking with proof is to be given with the acceptance letter. The ad-hoc appointment gives no stake/claim over the post; services will be terminated without notice when a regular appointee joins. Candidates already working in another organization/hospital must submit a relieving order before joining; without it, joining will not be allowed under any circumstances. A certificate of fitness from a registered medical practitioner must be submitted within 7 days of joining; the appointment is also subject to character and antecedent verification. Private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited, and Senior Residents will not work simultaneously as SR in any other hospital. Leave: 3½ days paid leave for 44 days of service; unauthorized absence for more than 7 days leads to termination, and no salary is paid for unauthorized absence, including strike. Resignation needs seven days prior notice or seven days salary in lieu; no TA/DA is paid for joining. Selected candidates must attend compulsory training on Bio-Medical Waste Management and Basic Life Support (BLS) within one month of joining.

For SC/ST/OBC candidates the appointment is provisional and subject to verification of the caste certificate. Doctors must wear a white coat with a name badge on duty and must not consume tobacco, alcohol or any intoxicant at the Institute. The experience certificate of SR ship is issued only after a No Dues Certificate along with the leave record. Contact numbers given in the notice: DSCI East EPABX +91-11-2213 5200, 2213 5700; DSCI West EPABX +91-11-2550 1111, 2554 1111; e-mail [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About DSCI
content_sections.text: Delhi State Cancer Institutes describes itself as "centres par excellence in the service of humanity" and is a group of autonomous institutions under the Govt of NCT of Delhi. It has two campuses: DSCI East at Dilshad Garden, Delhi 110095, and DSCI West at C-2/B, Janak Puri, New Delhi 110058. The notice is signed by the Director, DSCI, and the institute's website is https://dsci.delhi.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: DSCI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of duties under "Duty of Senior Residents", and it applies to all eight posts: The Senior Resident will be directly responsible for supervision of patient care in his/her unit with the assistance of Junior Residents, specially the emergency cases. He/she will be contacted by the Junior Residents on duty in case of emergency; if necessary, he/she should consult the physician/surgeon in-charge of the unit or specialist when available. He/she is liable to be posted to any set up managed by Delhi State Cancer Institute, whether in Delhi or Outside Delhi, at any stage. The appointing authority reserves the right to assign any duty as and when required within or outside the Institution. He/she will work under the residency scheme applicable from time to time. Selected Senior Residents in Clinical Oncology / Radiotherapy must also contact the Radio Safety Officer (RSO) of the Institute within a fortnight of joining for registration on the ELORA/ AERB Portal as radiation professionals.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled application form in the "Format of the Application Form" printed on page 7 of the notice. Coloured passport size photograph (the form also has a box to affix a recent passport size photograph). Copies of relevant certificates; the form asks for photocopies of the category certificate, qualification certificates from Matriculation onwards and experience certificates. Original certificates for scrutiny. Original documents for SC/ST/OBC candidates (category recognized by GNCT of Delhi only). DMC registration, or the receipt showing that DMC registration has been applied for. The application form asks for the post applied for, name (Dr.) in block letters, date of birth, father's/husband's name, address with PIN code, contact number with STD code, e-mail address, category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC), academic and professional qualifications, experience, any other information and the registration number (DMC/Others) with its validity, followed by a signed declaration. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates are registered at the Director's Office at DSCI (East) from 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM on 4 December 2026, and a personal interview follows. If the number of candidates in any discipline is more than five, they may be required to appear in a written exam and interview at a later date. A panel of wait-listed candidates will be prepared for vacancies arising in future; the panel remains valid for 44 days or till a fresh selection process is carried out, whichever is earlier. A selected candidate must report for acceptance of the offer letter within 7 days of its issue at the 2nd Floor Admin Block, Admin Branch (Recruitment), Delhi State Cancer Institute, Dilshad Garden, Delhi 110095, between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM noon, failing which the offer of appointment will stand cancelled/withdrawn. 1 passport size photographs Xth pass certificate (age proof) All MBBS Mark sheets MBBS Degree Attempt Certificate Internship Completion certificate PG pass certificate DMC Registration on PG Publications, if any Caste Certificate, if any Experience certificate, if any Identity proof viz. Aadhar Card, Voter ID Card, Driving License, Passport etc.

faq.question: Q1. When is the DSCI Senior Resident walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The DSCI walk-in interview for Senior Residents is on 4 December 2026 (Friday).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the DSCI walk-in?
faq.answer: Registration runs from 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM at the Director's Office at DSCI (East), Dilshad Garden, Delhi 110095.

faq.question: Q3. How many Senior Resident vacancies are in DSCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 40 posts across eight specialities, the largest being Clinical Oncology / Radiotherapy (11) and Onco-Anaesthesia (10); the number of posts may vary.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for DSCI Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: A recognized MBBS qualification, the speciality's PG qualification (such as MD/DNB, or DA, Diploma or DMRD where listed) and registration with Delhi Medical Council are required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DSCI Senior Resident 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 45 years as on date of interview, with relaxation at the discretion of the Selection Board/Governing Council of DSCI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a DSCI Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The pay is as per Pay Matrix Level 11, i.e. Rs. 67,700/- plus allowances.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the DSCI Senior Resident pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says the entitlement of H.R.A. will be as per Govt. Rules, in addition to Rs. 67700/- as per 7th CPC and other allowances.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the DSCI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application form, a coloured passport size photograph, copies of relevant certificates and the original certificates for scrutiny; SC/ST/OBC candidates must bring original category documents.

faq.question: Q9. How will DSCI select Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Selection is by personal interview on 4 December 2026; if more than five candidates turn up in any discipline, they may be required to appear in a written exam and interview at a later date.

faq.question: Q10. Is the DSCI Senior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on ad-hoc basis, initially for 44 days and extendable, with a maximum Senior Resident tenure of 03 years including previous tenure.
